transcript: If you're ever walking alone and feel like someone is following you, try this. Turn around and pretend you know them. Wave and say, hey, long time no see. This can confuse a potential attacker and make them think you recognize them, making them less likely to harm you. Trust your instincts. If something feels off, seek help immediately.
